notes: The San Francisco City Planning Commission's minutes of its meetings of 1996 (the Planning Commission from July, under the new Charter), from volume 42 of the San Francisco Public Library's deposit at the Internet Archive (42minutesofsanfran1996san). Action minutes, as in 1994-1995: each calendar item prints its case number and planner, the property with its assessor's block and lot, the request, the speakers by name, and the action with the vote and the motion or resolution number. From the spring the wireless-antenna applications carry a staff statement of what the building is and who uses it (a meat market and 28 flats, a synagogue, a sewage plant, a medical office building), which is where most of the year's statements of occupancy come from. Pages were split from the hOCR search text on the Internet Archive page index (whose first two fields are the text offsets), counting the viewer page among the leaves scandata.xml does not mark addToAccessFormats=false, and every page is dated from the meeting header it sits under. Three kinds of finding: what the Commission decided about a property, dated to the meeting that decided it; what the calendar states stood on or occupied the property; and landmark actions. A continuance, a withdrawal, a motion of intent, an item under 'Items to be continued' or an informational report is not a decision; a decision the Commission rescinded is replaced by the one it later took. The minutes name applicants, owners, architects, neighbours, objectors, commissioners and staff in every item; none of them is in any field. Companies, institutions, businesses and named buildings are kept.

coverage.remaining: Every page of volume 42 (42minutesofsanfran1996san, labelled 1996) was read: 44 regular meetings, 11 January to 19 December 1996, with their addenda, the special joint hearings with the Recreation and Park Commission (25 April), the Redevelopment Agency Commission and the General Services Administration (23 May, 24 October), and the closed and executive sessions of 25 April, 2 and 8 May, 11, 18 and 22 July, 15 August and 17 and 24 October. From 25 January the Commission cancelled fifth Thursdays (Resolution 14040), so there is no meeting of 29 February, 30 May, 29 August or 31 October; none is minuted for 4 July, 28 November or 26 December either. Next: volumes 43-58 (1997-2005).
coverage.note: 351 OCR pages with text out of 384 viewer pages (386 scanned leaves; the empty ones are blank versos, the library cards and the digitization notice), read in one session (44 meetings) by a single reader with no sub-agents. 228 findings: 214 decisions, 10 statements of what stood on or occupied a property, 4 landmark actions. The year the wireless-antenna applications filled the calendar (seven Pacific Bell rooftop sites approved together on 7 March, then guidelines in May and a moratorium in the autumn), of the 1000 Van Ness cinema complex, of the International Hotel site and the Colombo Building at Kearny and Columbus, of the Saint Paulus church fire and the rescission of Landmark 116, and of the Milo Hoadley Residence designated, rescinded and designated again.
